# High Roller Technologies Diamond Sponsor of the NEXTPredict 2026 Conference


October 19, 2026 8:15 am EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_5f515a2dbfbb6562e4cf83f40b3a0016/highroller/news/2026-10-19_High_Roller_Technologies_Diamond_Sponsor_of_the_170.pdf)


*Company’s new Chief Business Officer Flip Pidot will be one of the hosts of a key panel at NEXTPredict 2026*


*Prediction markets summit takes place October 22–23 at Hudson Yards in New York City*


LAS VEGAS, Nevada, Oct. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- High Roller Technologies, Inc. (“High Roller” or the “Company”) (NYSE: ROLR), an online gaming and prediction markets company, today announced that Chief Business Officer Flip Pidot will participate at NEXTPredict 2026, taking place October 22–23, 2026, at Hudson Yards in New York City. The Company’s prediction markets brand, ROLR™, is a Diamond level sponsor of the NEXTPredict 2026 conference.


Flip Pidot joins a panel focusing on one question: predict which party will hold the Senate after the midterms? This isn't political commentary - it's a high-conviction debate anchored on a single prediction-market contract. Each voice on stage takes a definitive position on the market and defends it with the data, the odds and the thesis behind the call. Recorded live as an episode of the Betting the Future podcast with Dalton Skach, it puts the smart money on the record, and on the line, before the results come in.


**Conference Details**


**Event:** NEXTPredict 2026
**Dates:** Thursday, October 22–Friday, October 23, 2026
**Location:** Hudson Yards, New York City


**Panel:** Flip Pidot, Chief Business Officer, High Roller Technologies
**Topic:** *Who Takes the Senate? A Live Market Debate*
**Date and Time:** October 23, 12:10 p.m. ET


**Agenda and registration:**[Registration](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=r9U7Z4QnJZNLOzQoMifIzuo5l9_zxTsOYIsa9uRI7yTN724TVONDBUjME-oJRaLGYouvhDX8DBNFjaBEr6tyclcITodZvj_5N_JvbnNExRQ=)


NEXTPredict brings together prediction markets operators, financial institutions, investors, technology providers and regulatory experts to discuss the industry’s development. The conference agenda addresses market structure, institutional participation, technology, consumer adoption and the evolving regulatory environment.


The conference’s speaker lineup includes executives from DraftKings, Robinhood, Crypto.com, Kalshi and Polymarket, alongside representatives from major financial institutions and media organizations.
